title: America Out-Drilled Saudi Arabia
hook: The US became the top driller.
source: U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA): US crude oil production bottomed at 5.0 million barrels/day in 2008, then nearly tripled to 13.2 million barrels/day in 2024 on the shale boom, making the US the world's largest crude producer since 2018. Saudi Arabia's production (EIA / OPEC data) peaked near 12.2 million barrels/day in 2018, fell to about 9.2 million during 2020's OPEC+ cuts, and stood at roughly 10.7 million barrels/day in 2024. 2014 figures for both countries are approximate, consistent with EIA's published trend.
